title: CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet
chineseTitle: 第 31 章：溪流与江河交汇处

paragraphs.en: Anne had a wonderful summer, relishing every moment outdoors in Lover's Lane and at Willowmere. Marilla allowed her free rein, though the Spencervale doctor warned her to keep Anne active in the open air all summer. This advice alarmed Marilla, who feared for Anne’s health.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮度过了一个美妙的夏天，尽情享受着在情人谷和柳林湾户外的每一刻时光。玛丽拉给了她充分的自由，尽管斯宾塞维尔的医生警告她要让安妮整个夏天都在户外保持活跃。这些建议让玛丽拉有些担心，因为她害怕安妮的身体会出问题。

paragraphs.en: As a result, Anne enjoyed a golden summer of freedom, walking, rowing, and berry-picking. By September, she was bright-eyed and full of ambition, ready to face the new school year with renewed zest.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，安妮度过了一个自由自在的金色夏日，尽情漫步、划船和采摘浆果。九月来临之际，她眼神明亮，充满雄心壮志，满怀热情地准备迎接新学年的到来。

paragraphs.en: Anne declared she was eager to study again, bringing her books down from the attic. She reminisced about her summer and how she felt ready to run a race, inspired by Mr. Allan's sermon. "He preaches magnificent sermons," she said, adding that Mrs. Lynde thought he was improving daily.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮表示她迫不及待地想要再次学习，便从阁楼上取下她的书籍。她回忆起这个夏天的经历，并感到自己像被艾伦先生的布道所激励一般，已经准备好迎接一场赛跑。“他的讲道真是精彩绝伦，”她说，又补充道雷切尔·林德太太认为他每天都在进步。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Lynde believed Mr. Allan might be recruited by a city church soon, leaving Avonlea without him. Anne disagreed, suggesting they should enjoy his presence while it lasted. She mused about becoming a minister herself, believing women could have great influence if their theology was sound and that preaching would be thrilling.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德太太认为艾伦先生可能会被城市教会招募，不久后就会离开埃文利。安妮不同意这个看法，建议大家在艾伦先生还在的时候好好享受他的陪伴。她不禁想到自己或许也能成为一名牧师，相信如果神学观点正确，女性也可以产生巨大的影响，并且布道会非常激动人心。

paragraphs.en: "Why can't women be ministers?" she asked Marilla, who responded dryly that Mrs. Lynde had been shocked by the idea. According to her, female ministers existed in America but not yet in Canada.
paragraphs.zh: “为什么女人不能当牧师？”她问玛丽拉，玛丽拉干巴巴地回答说雷切尔·林德女士对这个想法感到震惊。据她说，在美国或许有女牧师，但在加拿大还不存在这样的情况。

paragraphs.en: Anne continued, noting how women often took on church work like socials and fundraising. She believed Mrs. Lynde could preach well with practice.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮继续说道，她注意到许多女性常常承担起教堂里的社交活动和筹款工作。她相信，在多加练习之后，雷切尔·林德太太完全可以成为一名出色的布道者。

paragraphs.en: Marilla agreed, saying Rachel's oversight ensured Avonlea remained on the right path.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉赞同这一看法，认为雷切尔的疏忽确保了埃文利镇依然走在正确的道路上。

paragraphs.en: Anne turned to Marilla with confidence. "Marilla," she began, "I need your advice on something that's been troubling me, especially on Sunday afternoons when I reflect deeply about such matters. When I'm with you or Mrs. Allan or Miss Stacy, I strive to be good and want to please you.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮充满信心地转向玛丽拉：“玛丽拉，”她开始说，“我有些事情想征求你的意见。特别是在星期日下午，当我深思这些问题时，总是让我感到困扰。和你或者艾伦太太或斯蒂西小姐在一起的时候，我总是努力做好事，希望取悦你们。

paragraphs.en: But when I'm with Mrs. Lynde, I feel overwhelmingly tempted to do exactly what she forbids. Why is this happening? Do you think it's because I'm fundamentally bad?"
paragraphs.zh: 但一和雷切尔·林德太太在一起，我就忍不住要做她明令禁止的事情。这是为什么呢？你觉得这说明我本质上就是个坏孩子吗？

paragraphs.en: Marilla hesitated for a moment before laughing. "If that were true," she said, "I suppose I am too, Anne. Rachel often has the same effect on me.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉犹豫了一下，才笑了起来。“要是真这样的话，”她说，“那我也算是一个。雷切尔经常也会对我产生同样的效果。”

paragraphs.en: You say herself that she can have more of an influence for good if she didn't nag so much. There should be a commandment against nagging. But still, I shouldn't speak ill of her.
paragraphs.zh: 你说过，如果她不再那么啰嗦，就能更好地发挥影响力。应该有一条诫命禁止啰嗦才对。不过我还是不应该说她的不是。

paragraphs.en: She's a kind Christian woman who means well and does her share of work."
paragraphs.zh: 她是一位心地善良、信仰虔诚的女性，做事也很尽责。

paragraphs.en: Anne felt relieved when Marilla agreed with her about growing up. "It’s encouraging," she said firmly. "I won’t worry as much now, but there will always be new things to think about."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮见玛丽拉同意她关于成长的看法，感到松了口气。“这让人放心，”她坚定地说，“我现在不会那么担心了，但总会有新的事情需要思考。”

paragraphs.en: She continued, "When you start maturing, there are so many decisions to make. It keeps me busy all the time. Marilla, do you think I’ll grow up successfully with friends like you and Matthew?"
paragraphs.zh: 她继续说道：“当你开始渐渐长大，就要面对许多重要的选择。这让我一直忙个不停。玛丽拉，你觉得有你们这样的朋友陪伴，我能顺利成长吗？”

paragraphs.en: Marilla admitted that it was important to grow up right. Anne had grown two inches over the summer, and her dresses were now longer. "The dark-green one is pretty," she said, grateful for the flounce added by Miss Stacy.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉承认，健康成长非常重要。安妮在夏天长了两英寸，裙子也变长了。“深绿色的那条很好看，”她说，感激斯蒂西小姐加上的那层花边。

paragraphs.en: At Avonlea school, Miss Stacy returned to find all pupils eager for work again. The Queen's class was particularly motivated as they faced the upcoming Entrance exam at the end of the year. Anne worried about not passing, a thought that plagued her throughout winter afternoons and dreams.
paragraphs.zh: 在埃文利学校，斯泰西小姐回到教室时发现所有学生都急切地等待上课。女王班的学生尤其积极，因为他们即将面临年末的入学考试。安妮担心自己可能无法通过，这种担忧在冬日的午后和梦中一直困扰着她。

paragraphs.en: Despite these concerns, the winter was busy and enjoyable. Schoolwork remained interesting, and class rivalry was intense. New ideas and ambitions opened up for Anne, making her feel excited about unexplored knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，这个冬天既忙碌又愉快。学校里的功课依旧引人入胜，班级间的竞争也异常激烈。新的思想和抱负为安妮打开了新天地，让她对未知的知识充满了兴奋之情。

paragraphs.en: "Hills peeped over hill and Alps on Alps arose," she mused, reflecting on the new horizons ahead.
paragraphs.zh: 她沉思着，展望未来广阔的天地：“群山此起彼伏，连绵不绝，阿尔卑斯山脉仿佛一层层叠起。”

paragraphs.en: Miss Stacy's guidance led Anne to explore new ideas, much to the surprise of Mrs. Lynde and the school trustees who were skeptical about such innovations. Anne expanded socially with Marilla’s approval, attending occasional outings and participating in activities like the Debating Club, which held several concerts.
paragraphs.zh: 史蒂西小姐的指导让安妮探索了新的思想，这让雷切尔·林德太太和学校董事会感到惊讶。他们对这类创新持怀疑态度。在玛丽拉的同意下，安妮的社会生活也有所扩展，她偶尔参加郊游，并参与辩论俱乐部等课外活动，该俱乐部还举办了几场音乐会。

paragraphs.en: Anne grew rapidly, surprising Marilla one day when they stood side by side. "How you've grown!" exclaimed Marilla, feeling a mix of joy and sadness as she realized her child was now a tall, serious girl.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮迅速长高，有一天玛丽拉和她并肩站立时大吃一惊。“你长得真快！”玛丽拉脱口而出，心中交织着喜悦与一丝伤感，意识到自己的女儿已经变成了一个高挑而严肃的少女。

paragraphs.en: That night, after Anne left for prayer meeting with Diana, Marilla sat alone in the twilight, overcome with emotion. Matthew found her crying and laughed through his tears when she explained her feelings about missing Anne.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，安妮和戴安娜去参加祈祷会后，玛丽拉独自坐在黄昏中，情绪激动。马修发现她在哭泣，她解释说思念安妮的感受时，他透过泪水笑了出来。

paragraphs.en: Marilla noted another change: Anne became quieter, using fewer big words and talking less overall. "You don't chatter half as much," commented Marilla, curious about the shift in Anne's behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉注意到又有了变化：安妮变得安静了许多，使用的词汇也不那么复杂了，说话的次数也少了。“你没以前爱唠叨了。”玛丽拉好奇于安妮行为的变化，这样评论道。

paragraphs.en: Anne blushed and giggled, looking out the window where spring sunshine had caused red buds on the creeper to burst open.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮脸红了，咯咯笑着，望着窗外。春天的阳光让攀缘植物上的红色花蕾绽放了。

paragraphs.en: "I don't want to talk much anymore," she said, tapping her chin thoughtfully. "It's nicer to keep dear thoughts in my heart like treasures. I don’t like them being laughed at or questioned."
paragraphs.zh: “我不大想多说了，”她沉思着轻敲了下下巴，“把那些珍贵的想法藏在心里，就像宝贝一样，感觉更好。我不喜欢它们被取笑或质疑。”

paragraphs.en: She continued, "I also don't want to use big words as much now that I'm growing up. It’s almost a pity, Marilla, because Miss Stacy says short words are stronger and better. She makes us write simply, which was hard at first but is now easier."
paragraphs.zh: 她继续说道：“我现在长大了，也不怎么爱用那些大词了。玛丽拉，其实挺可惜的，斯泰西小姐说短词更有力量也更好。她让我们写得简单些，一开始还挺难适应的，但现在倒习惯了。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla asked, "What about your story club? You haven’t mentioned it in a while."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉问道：“你的故事俱乐部怎么样了？你有一阵子没提起了。”

paragraphs.en: "It doesn't exist anymore," Anne replied. "We didn’t have time for it, and we got tired of writing about love, murder, elopements, and mysteries. Miss Stacy sometimes has us write stories, but only those that could happen in Avonlea.
paragraphs.zh: “现在已经没有了，”安妮回答说，“我们没时间写，而且写那些关于爱情、谋杀、私奔和谜案的故事让我们腻味了。斯泰西小姐有时会让我们写些故事，但只能是发生在埃文利镇上的。”

paragraphs.en: She criticizes our work harshly, making us critique ourselves too."
paragraphs.zh: 她对我们的工作严加批评，让我们不得不自我反省。

paragraphs.en: Anne added, "I never realized my compositions had so many faults until I started looking for them myself. But Miss Stacy said I could learn to write well if I trained myself to be my own strictest critic. So that’s what I’m doing."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮补充说：“直到我自己开始寻找这些缺点，我才意识到我的作品中有这么多不足之处。不过斯泰西小姐说过，如果我能训练自己成为最严格的自我批评者，就能学会写好文章。所以这就是我现在在做的事情。”

paragraphs.en: Anne was uncertain about her exams, feeling relieved one moment and terrified the next. Despite hard work and Miss Stacy's thorough preparation, she worried they might still fail. Each girl had a subject she struggled with: geometry for Anne, Latin for Jane, algebra for Ruby and Charlie, and arithmetic for Josie.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮对自己的考试感到不确定，一会儿觉得松了口气，一会儿又害怕得要命。尽管她努力学习，斯泰西小姐也做了充分的准备，但她仍然担心自己可能会失败。每个女孩都有一个让她头疼的科目：安妮是几何，简是拉丁文，露比和查理是代数，乔西则是算术。

paragraphs.en: Moody Spurgeon feared he would fail English history.
paragraphs.zh: 莫迪·斯普尔仁担心自己可能会在英语历史课上不及格。

paragraphs.en: Miss Stacy planned difficult June exams to mirror the Entrance exam standards. This added pressure haunted Anne. She often woke at night wondering about failure.
paragraphs.zh: 斯泰西小姐计划了艰难的六月考试，以模拟入学考试的标准。这种压力常常困扰着安妮，让她经常在夜间醒来时担心失败。

paragraphs.en: Marilla suggested retaking school if she failed, but Anne lacked the resolve. Failing alongside her friends would be a disgrace. Her nervousness in exams might lead to poor performance.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉建议如果考试不及格就重读一年，但安妮缺乏这样的决心。与朋友们一同挂科对她来说是个耻辱。她在考试中的紧张可能会导致成绩不佳。

paragraphs.en: Anne sighed and focused on her book, ignoring the spring's allure. She knew there would be more springs, but failing the Entrance exam might prevent her from enjoying them fully.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮叹了口气，专心阅读手中的书，忽略了泉水的诱惑。她知道还会遇到更多的泉水，但这次入学考试失利可能会让她无法尽情享受它们的美好。
